nodes.text: Apropos Magazine. Culture with opinions. Free of advertising.
What we watch, hear, read and play

Apropos Magazine is an independent Danish culture publication featuring reviews, essays and perspectives on music, film, television, books, art, gaming and cultural life. Our articles are free to read. We carry no advertisements, native advertising or sponsored editorial content. Apropos Magazine is published by Apropos Creative ApS, CVR 38175661.

Culture deserves attention, even when it comes without a big marketing budget. Our ambition is to create a publication with room for curiosity, criticism and depth. We look closely at the works, the experiences and the questions they raise, with personality and space for an independent opinion. Being free of advertising is part of that choice: no one can buy an editorial recommendation from Apropos.
